name: dogfood-oidc-federation-rp
description: Nuxt 3 Relying Party (RP) for the dogfood-oidc-federation app. Sub-Issue v1.21-4c wires the authorization code flow — /authorize builds the request (state + nonce + PKCE), /callback receives the code + state and exchanges it for an id_token + userinfo. Sub-Issue v1.21-4d layers JWKS rotation e2e on top.
